Visit note | 2025-08-16 10:30 AM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Taslima Sarkar, 26, female. Ms. Sarkar comes in for a review regarding pimples and blackheads on her face, marks left after pimples, and spots on her back. She mentions that her skin has been worse since working in a hot kitchen in Farmgate. She reports no other major health issues and denies any severe systemic symptoms. On examination: about 19 inflamed spots on the face, BP 114/74 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, weight 70 kg. Skin shows moderate inflammatory papules and comedones. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and do not squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Visit note | 2025-08-16 10:30 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Nargis Gazi, 32, female. Mrs. Gazi attends for follow-up reporting a throbbing headache on one side, light hurting her eyes, and needing to lie in a dark room. She notes experiencing flashing zigzag lights before the attacks and tingling in one hand, with attacks triggered by skipping meals while travelling in Old Dhaka. She works as a delivery rider. Comorbidities are none. On examination: about 8 headache days a month, BP 110/71 mmHg, pulse 78 bpm, weight 75 kg. Neurological exam is otherwise unremarkable. Assessment: Migraine. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up in 3 months with the headache diary.

Visit note | 2025-08-16 10:30 AM | Dr. Fahmida Yasmin, ENT | Patient: Prosenjit Bose, 19, male. Mr. Bose presents for his first visit complaining of a blocked nose and pressure over the cheeks and forehead. He states that the symptoms began after diving at a pool in Khulna. He works as a garment factory worker. He has no chronic medical conditions. Examination reveals tenderness over the maxillary sinuses. On examination: temperature 99.4°F, BP 115/76 mmHg, pulse 104 bpm, weight 89 kg. Nasal mucosa is congested. Assessment: Acute sinusitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use steam inhalation twice daily and drink warm fluids. Follow-up in 10 days.

Visit note | 2025-08-16 03:30 PM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Tahsin Munshi, 70, female. Mrs. Munshi presents for her initial consultation reporting that she is always feeling cold and feels slow and tired. She mentions that she first noticed these troubling symptoms when a cold winter in Motijheel felt much harder than usual. She works as a retired civil servant and has a history of Bronchial asthma, which she manages with an inhaler when needed. She denies chest pain, palpitations, or significant weight fluctuations, but notes persistent sluggishness affecting her daily activities. On physical examination today, her blood pressure is 117/74 mmHg, her pulse rate is 91 beats per minute with a regular rhythm, and her weight is recorded at 78 kg. Her skin feels cool and dry, and deep tendon reflexes show delayed relaxation. Laboratory investigations performed prior to the visit show a TSH level of 10.6 mIU/L, confirming underactive thyroid function. Assessment: Hypothyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued to start thyroid hormone replacement therapy. She was advised to keep a regular sleep routine and eat a balanced diet. Follow-up is scheduled in 6 weeks with a repeat TSH test.

Visit note | 2025-08-17 04:30 PM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Shyamal Bose, 49, male. Mr. Bose presents for his initial medical consultation today reporting a bothersome skin complaint. He describes experiencing a ring-shaped itchy red rash, a rash with spreading edges, and notes that the itch is noticeably worse in humid weather. When asked about his background, he mentions he is employed as a textile engineer and that the symptoms began after playing football on wet fields in Cox's Bazar. On physical examination, his blood pressure is recorded at 128/81 mmHg, his pulse is 91 beats per minute, and his weight is 57 kilograms. A therapeutic management plan was discussed, and a prescription was issued for targeted topical antifungal therapy.
